title: Supreme Court upholds pause on Trump's anti-trans prison policy
summary: The Supreme Court ruled Wednesday that the Trump administration has to continue providing gender-affirming care to inmates in federal prisons as litigation on efforts to change the policy continues.
contentText:
The Supreme Court ruled Wednesday that the Trump administration has to continue providing gender-affirming care to inmates in federal prisons as litigation on efforts to change the policy continues.

(Image credit: Saul Loeb/AFP via Getty Images)
